reviews.title: Terrible Service
reviews.text: Worst services. The staff, Steven Jimenez was rude, and not knowledgeable of what to do as a costumer service representative. Bad experience!
reviews.author: Sandra C

reviews.title: Trip to San Jose
reviews.text: Awful customer service at Golfito airport. Person that was checking us in was rude and not knowledgeable at his duties. Unpleasant situation concerning the staff working at the Golfito airport. Would not recommend.
reviews.author: Marie C

reviews.title: SECOND EVERYONES REVIEW DO NOT FLIGHT SANSA!!!
reviews.text: Do yourself a favor and go to green airways, SANSA is absolutely unreliable and will leave the passengers stranded at their convenience, expensive obviously reasonable? Not even a little bit won’t even give you a refund or even a new flight. Bought a flight for a friend and ended up loosing the money.
reviews.author: Yindra L

reviews.title: Wonderful flight! An exciting part of our trip that we didn't expect
reviews.text: This was the part of the trip that I was most nervous about and it went GREAT. I was so worried that our luggage would be too big or overweight but it all went super smoothly. In SJ, we arrived about an hour before and got weighed with our carry on (!) and then waited in a lobby for our flight. Every twenty minutes or so they would read a list of names and then you just got on the plane and took off shortly after! In Puerto Jimenez, it was a bit different. We got there an hour before and weighed and theres just a little building with some chairs and a shop. About half an hour before or flight- they loaded us up and we took off! So cool and great views!! Highly recommend (and don't stress about the weight limits like I did!)
reviews.author: Kimberly G

reviews.title: 5 Good Flights
reviews.text: Since October I have taken 5 SANSA flights (Quepos - SanJose (3) and a trip San Jose - Tortuguero - San Jose) I have had no issues with any of them. All were either on time or early. The pilots seemed competent and professional. The check-in staff were fine. The planes appeared to be in good condition and clean. That said, it’s all about knowing what to expect and understanding the fare rules and terms and conditions - especially cancellation and refund policies. I travel light - so baggage weight has not been an issue. I also do not book far in advance or take flights that have to make same day connections as I know that “things can happen” not only on SANSA but on all airlines The planes are small. The purpose is to quickly get you from point A to B. One has to understand that weight and balance is very important. They weigh both you and your baggage and are strict about overweight bags. Except for SJO, don’t expect much at the airports or any in flight amenities. But all that is Ok since the flights are short. There is no wait for bags as they bring it to you on the tarmac just as you get off the plane. For me SANSA has worked well and I have enjoyed the scenery on the flights. I thought Tortuguero air strip (you can’t call it an airport) was an interesting experience and experiences is what travel is about. SANSA may not be for everyone. However considering I have experienced 5 issueless flights in the last 6 months, for it has worked well for me.
reviews.author: raquel_z 🙊🙉🙈🐒

reviews.title: Arrival fine, Departure disgraceful -Sansa need to wake up
reviews.text: We flew in from San Jose to Puerto Jimenez on Sansa. We weren’t advised of any weight restrictions prior, advised this was an “economy” flight. We had no flight number, nothing. Got bags weighed then ourselves and overweight where not only we paid excess but bags bumped as well. Carmen who met us in Puerto Jimenez is delightful. Arrival area very basic but they had lovely cold drinks waiting and air conditioning and lovely clean toilets. Departure, how disgusting. Staff far from friendly. Dirty disgusting sitting area in the heat. Broken seats and absolutely filthy toilets that are unusable. Again bags and us weighed and excess weight paid for. Thankfully Carmen came and got us and walked us around to arrival room. We were very thankful. Sansa really need to send management to look at departure area. Disgraceful. And high praise to Carmen.
reviews.author: Lisa L

reviews.title: Three Largely Trouble free Flights on SANSA
reviews.text: In early March my wife and I took 3 flights on SANSA four days apart. First was from San Jose to Drake Bay for visiting the Osa Peninsula and then four days later we returned to San Jose for a connecting flight to La Fortuna for visiting the Arenal area. Apart from the first flight which was 45 minutes late departing from SJO all other flights were on time and we really enjoyed the experience of seeing a lot of Costa Rica from the air. Some practical tips to be aware of: - at check-in we just needed a passport to get boarding passes - they weigh your checked luggage piece separate to the the passenger plus whatever you are taking into the cabin. We were both traveling with a carryon sized suitcase (which we checked) and a small day pack each which we carried on - when you board the 12-seat Beach craft there is an area at at the back of the plane for leaving day packs etc. - apart from the first row behind the pilots the seating space is tight and the alley equally narrow. These are small planes but everybody gets a good view. - do not expect much in the way of airstrip facilities outside of San Jose which had bathrooms, a cafe and small shop at the domestic terminal. The terminal buildings at Drake Bay and La Fortuna were pretty modern with bathrooms but Tortuguero which was a stop on the way to La Fortuna, looked like an ancient shack about to fall down! Finally, we booked these flights via an in-country travel who had a 24-hour emergency tel # . This was our contingency measure in case of any issues with the flights which fortunately we never had.
reviews.author: PaulH-nova

reviews.title: No problems but a point off for anxiety after reading reviews from others
reviews.text: We've done four flights with this airline and never had a negative experience. However, after reading other reviews certainly makes one anxious. Yes, they weigh your luggage and have a fee for over 30 lbs. They also weigh the passenger with their carry on. Once all passengers are accounted for they take off. Twice 30 minutes early. If the weight goes over they will bump luggage until another flight so pack light.
reviews.author: Richard H

reviews.title: San Jose to Nosara BEWARE
reviews.text: I've been flying for 50 plus years. A pilot for 30 years. By far the worst flying experience EVER. Not the service, but he pilot in command. Almost crashed on landing in Nosara. He landed the plane downwind with too much airspeed. Flew the plane in to the ground and upon landing forced a huge bounce/ porpoising. Plane became airborne again before stalling back to the ground. My pregnant daughter was on onboard and sore for days after. Other passengers were stunned. The pilot should have aborted the attempt at landing and gone around to try again. We were very lucky to walk away. I tried to contact Sansa to report but no success.
reviews.author: Mobile67929554990

reviews.title: Terrible service and rude!!
reviews.text: Arrived 30 minutes prior to my flight and got checked in. Once I passed security, one of the clerks came and said I was too late for my flight and asked me to walk back. out with her, taking my ticket. There were others in line with me who checked in at the same time and they were able to board! The clerk who couldn't speak English told me I needed to buy another ticket. I walked over to the next counter at Costa Green and they helped me immediately for the next flight over. Choose Costa Green!
reviews.author: C L

reviews.title: No Information, Lies, and Even Less Assistance
reviews.text: We had a great week on the Osa Penninsula! We were headed back to SJO from Puerto Jimenez to catch our flight home. We left 4 hours for a 45 minute flight. Got there early, checked in, and then they said our flight was late. OK, it happens. However, there were multiple flights to SJO that morning and they would not move anyone onto the 3 flights that were functioning. One by one people missed their flights in San Jose. And they would lie and say it took off. An hour later: it will take off soon. Finally 3 hours later, it landed within 5 minutes of another flight. We asked if our flight could take off first since there was still a chance for some of us. They said Of Course! Another lie. Never an apology. Nothing. No offer of putting us up in a hotel if we missed our flight. Finally took off and the co-pilot looked like he was nodding off. Since they seem to have a monopoly, it really affects my thoughts about returning to Costa Rica. I would never want to fly on that airline again.
reviews.author: PatfromArlingfun

reviews.title: Promised a refund, never received it
reviews.text: .I booked fully flexible tickets with Sansa on July 2022, then I decided to cancel them due to so many bad reviews. I contacted the reservations department and I was told I would receive a refund. Yet, no refund 6 months later and absolutely no answer on any of my emails
reviews.author: marsidorita

reviews.title: Disappointed with their service
reviews.text: So very disappointed in this airline! Don’t use them, drive instead. I received the wrong information and ended up not needing them for our trip. So I tried to cancel the flight, less than 24hrs after making it. ALL of their tickets are non refundable and they don’t tell you that till AFTER you purchase them. I was prepared to pay a penalty but nope they wouldn’t even do that. My trip isn’t for a month so it wasn’t like it was a last minute cancellation. Don’t use them, drive!
reviews.author: Tracie R

reviews.title: Worst airline in the world
reviews.text: Incredibly high prices, horrible customer service. And they really don't care since they are the only airline offering domestic flights in Costa Rica. Better off with a five hour drive....
reviews.author: Maya O

reviews.title: In Smaller Planes You Know You're Flying!
reviews.text: Destinations by air within Costa Rica are pretty much all less than 1 hour from San Jose. Sansa is by far the easiest way to go. While driving will allow you to see more of the countryside and stop to take photos, the roads in Costa Rica are good but not the best and with maximum speeds of 60 - 80 km/h, a 160 kms can take 3 - 3.5 hours depending on the volume of traffic. We flew return from San Jose to Limon for US$250/person each way. The flight was 30 minutes while the drive would have been in excess of 4 hours!! The planes are mostly 12 seaters so you fly relatively low and get some great arial views!! The aisles are very tight but the seats are great. Sansa staff is friendly and helpful. These are short, quick flights ... sit back and enjoy!
reviews.author: Douglas Bartholomew-Saunders

reviews.title: Everything went smoothly
reviews.text: Just want to counterbalance a few of the reviews. While I'm sure things can and do) go wrong on occasion, we had a perfectly smooth experience from check-in to the conclusion of our 40 minute flight from Drake Bay to SJO (note that TA doesn't list Drake Bay as an origin, so I had to put Liberia). Friendly pilots, excellent scenery, safe and on-time. No issue with our bags (we paid for the higher fair to have 40 lbs). Only challenge was originally booking the flight as the website was being redone. It's possible to fly Sansa and have it be a great experience.
reviews.author: Heather O

reviews.title: DO NOT FLY - Shady Business
reviews.text: When I booked, I confirmed the cancellation policy was as listed on my booking confirmation, 85% as long as it's more than 10 days before the flight. I ended up needing to cancel and made MANY attempts via phone AND email to cancel the flight. The airline stopped responding. They didn't pick up the phone, they didn't respond to my emails. I then opened an investigation into the charge with my credit company, and Sansa misrepresented the cancellation policy, telling my credit card company that the ticket was non-refundable. I've now had to submit more proof to claim the refund I was owed. You are better off driving or being driven. This is an irresponsible, shady business. My experience seems to match many of the other reviewers.
reviews.author: Evan M

reviews.title: Worst Service Imaginable
reviews.text: Wow, I have never had a more disappointing experience with an airline in my life. This company will sell more seats than they have available and then will CANCEL your entire flight 3 HOURS after the initial departure time. Once the flight was canceled we were told the only way to have your flight refunded was to wait with the gate agent. Now picture this, this 7pm on a Saturday night in Puerto Viejo. The car rental kiosks at the airport close at 8pm. So we could either wait in the 100+ person line with all the other angry passenger or we could leave the airport and try to rent a car to make the 5 hr. drive to Puerto Viejo de Talamanca. We did not wait in line at the airport. I figured we could contact customer service after and speak with them. However, SANSA airline did not officially cancel the flight. The were no flight records recording the cancellation and the airline never sent out an email regarding the changing flight plans. Because there was no proof that SANSA canceled the flight… not only would the airline not refund me the cost for the tickets ($600 USD). But because there was no record of the flight cancellation, my bank could not issue a chargeback, and when they contacted SANSA to confirm the cancellation the were never contacted back via phone or email. In fact, I emailed SANSA customer service also and they NEVER replied. Do not use SANSA airlines. I am begging you, it is so much better to drive across Costa Rica than it is to have to rely on such a corrupt and disingenuous company. SANSA sets a terrible precedent for an otherwise lovely country, culture, and people. Oh PS, the staff at the airport were all rude (except for the luggage handlers) and kept ignoring my friends and I until I spoke to them in Spanish… which pissed them off even more because they couldn’t pretend to be ignorant after that.
reviews.author: Elizabeth P

reviews.title: MIssed my flight - no answer from Sansa!
reviews.text: I had booked a flight with Sansa for december 4th at 5 pm from Quepos to San Jose. When I got to the airport, there was no one from Sansa. An employee of another company (Green Airways) told me that the Sansa flight had been rescheduled to 2 pm. He was very helpful and even called Sansa for me where I was told that they had informed me about the rescheduling by mail. I had never gotten a mail or a call from Sansa! I had to book another flight with Green Airways (nice, dependable, cheeper than Sansa) to get back to San Jose. I sent a written complaint ( in perfect spanish!) to Sansa and I never got an answer. So they still owe me 137$! Avoid Sansa, there are other companies you can use!
reviews.author: Swissturist

reviews.title: 5 flights on my trip, GREAT airline.
reviews.text: I flew with SANSA 5 times in Oct 2022, for my vacation connecting multiple cities. They were great, I would fly with them again for sure. -I flew from San Jose, to Tortuguero, then tortuguero to Drake bay connecting in San Jose, then from Drake bay to Liberia again connecting in San Jose. 5 flights in total. -San Jose: I arrived to the domestic terminal about 3/2.5 hours before the flight to tortuguero. Right inside the door is the airline checkin counters, there was no line. Fast check in, they weigh the checked bags, and then way me with my backpack on. Checked bags are taken and you are sent to security. Its a small security straight ahead from the main door, again no line at all, straight through. A small gate waiting area, but there seemed to be enough seats, in all 5 flights i never saw the seats full. There is nice washrooms, and a single shop, Terra tico. It sells drinks, coffee, snacks, sandwiches and some souvenirs. I personally didnt like any of the 3 food items i bought from the shop. So i was 2.5 hours early and check in/security took about 5 min. If i knew that i would have arrived maybe 1.5 hours before (SANSA requires 55 min before departure). Even though it was scheduled for around 12pm, it took off 10 or 20 min early. I think all passengers arrived and plane was ready so we left. You get a plastic borading pass, at check in that you give back before you walk out to plane. The Gate is just a door to outside, and you are lead by the first officer of your plane, down a set of stairs (ramp is there too) and across the tarmac to your plane. Overall very fast and easy boarding and check in. There is security around the lobby and taxi drivers waiting for passengers. I left my bags a few meters away, in sight, as i took a picture of the domestic terminal sign and the security got excited. Dont leave your bags anywhere, even in sight. -All the planes are the same type, Cessna grand caravan 208-B. There is not much head room when walking inside (you are literally doubled over), and the aisle is very narrow. But it was a nice little plane, safety cards in the seat pockets. The speakers to hear the captain talking were not very clear at all, i could not hear what they were saying. This plane flies above the clouds. -The Pilots and first officers were great, very polite, good flyers, All 5 captains signed my log book for each flight. I had one repeat pilot, from san jose to tortuguero then san jose to drake bay, he was great. Another great pilot is the one from drake bay to san jose; i was running late for the plane because my hotel driver had a flat tire, change car and then a river too deep over a road so had to walk through with my luggage over head, and a 3rd car to airport, when i arrived the plane was sitting there waiting (with 7 passengers) and the airport staff met me at the door to get my bags and check me in fast, and get me on the plane. The pilot was there waiting too, so i was very happy that he didnt just take off and go, but waited. We still took off before the departure time, but i arrived less then 30 min before that time. -Tortuguero airport - Not really a airport, just a runway. There is a SANSA employee that comes from town in a water taxi to weigh people and bags on a small step scale, and he puts the wheel blocks for the plane. He will also taxi you to town after you arrive for 10$ US, but you have to wait until the plane you landed on gets loaded with new passengers luggage and passengers and takes off. Then he will go back to town. The landing strip has no security at all, just a fence, but there is multiple access points from the beach, and a water taxi dock. There is a old abandoned building, but the employee told me it is not owned by the airport or airlines, and is just abandoned, so passengers sit under it waiting for planes. -Drake bay airport - This is a small one room airport, no security, waiting area and ticket counters by the door to the runway. Warning: there is river over road on the
reviews.author: Adam C

reviews.title: They lied to me, I was never refunded
reviews.text: I had to cancel the tickets 2 months before my trip, and i received an email confirmation by sansa verifying my refund. They said it’s taking from 1 to 3 months to get the refund. 7 months later they are not even replying to my mails.
reviews.author: Marcidorita

reviews.title: Mr
reviews.text: If I could give this sorry excuse for an airline less than 1 star I would. Customer service is non existent as I have been on hold multiple times indefinitely upto 97 min. We booked a one way from airport to airport to then be told the flight had to be divided into to planes because of weight. Even though I explained to them we had a connecting flight we couldn’t miss, they still decided to place us on the second plane rather than the one that was already there but assured us we wouldn’t miss the flight. Well, the plane we we were suppose to get on didn’t arrive for another hour and 20 min. and then decided to make a stop at another airport to pick up more passengers before then headed to SJO. Of course all of this happened without our knowledge. Needless to say we missed our flight. We now have to stay in Costs rica another 24 hours and incur all the added expenses like booking a Hotel for a night transportation to and from and the $200 penalty from spirit airlines. And of course I try calling them and sending them emails after this wonderful experience and no one picks up or answers regardless of day and time. Needless to say I’d throw on a pair of gasoline soaked pampers and walk through hell before I fly with them again.
reviews.author: Joel M

reviews.title: They are simply thiefs and customer support is terrible
reviews.text: Given high traffic in Costa Rica is very likely to get delays when arriving to the airport. They do not care about it and don't wait a single minute. They even change the depart time to convenience and not a single show of empathy to customers (will not reimburse and will charge you for another flight anyway). I recommend to rent a car to move within Costa Rica or use the other airline Green Airways which is way much better.
reviews.author: José Andrés M

reviews.title: TI-Box must stand for Tiny Box
reviews.text: OMG, what a trip. First of all, there is really no airport at Tortuguero. A Sansa agent shows up at the airstrip about a half hour before the flight with a portable scale. We were limited to no more than 30lbs but we knew this ahead of time. The Cessna Grand Caravan we flew in seated 12 and I say seated in a general way as you are literally crammed in there. You have to duck your head to get to your seat. BTW, I would not recommend this flight to anyone who is mobility impaired. We actually flew to another small airport in La Fortuna. It was quite an adventure but we all arrived safe.
reviews.author: County-Hunter

reviews.title: Horrible experience ever from reservation and customer support
reviews.text: Horrible experience ever from reservation and customer support . The way they solved the situation was to hand up the phone.
reviews.author: Liat B

reviews.title: WORST EXPERIENCE!
reviews.text: I do not recommend this airline to anyone! They are extremely rude and unprofessional. I wish I rented a car and drove 4-5 hours to get to my destination then to Have gone with them. We only arrived 2 minutes late and had to pay $85 to rebook and wait 3 hours for our next flight. I will not recommend or revisit them ever again!
reviews.author: Annabel

reviews.title: Fraud,
reviews.text: My wife and I arrived to the airport 5 minutes late due to a flight delay from our origin country, the clerk charged me “$80 to rebook us on a later flight” because our “flight ticket was canceled”. The “manager” literally said “your flight delay is not my problem, this is the policy”… this is a gringo tax policy. If you book with them, just make sure you land 5 hours early and your bags weigh exactly the allotted weight because they are opportunities thieves.
reviews.author: Harutyun G

reviews.title: Horrible!!!  The worst
reviews.text: The worst customer service ever! They cancelled the flight the day before I arrived and wouldn't give me my money back. I was unable to make the flight that the rescheduled since it was 20 minutes after I landed in San Jose. NO response from customer service about a credit until I threatened to call consumer protection. Gave a hard time when I finally went to book flight with the credit that they finally issued. Horrible Horrible Horrible
reviews.author: Sobrien25

reviews.title: Great customer service!
reviews.text: There is a reason there is a weight limit for luggage (and why you need to be truthful about your own weight) on these planes- they are small, and the climate here requires a lot of skilled navigation. I had a bad experience yesterday but it was the fault of fellow travelers who brought an absurd amount of luggage. Our bags had to be delivered later that day. Then there was a storm and they could not fly until the morning. I was very annoyed because I had no clean clothes or toiletries and had to go buy some at an overpriced tourist shop. But not annoyed at the airline, Sansa did everything they could to rectify it. They were better than any large airline I’ve had luggage issues with. The customer service has been amazing too.
reviews.author: Lindsay C

reviews.title: Sansa airline
reviews.text: 10 day before my flight I notified this company that I had Covid and may not be able to travel that I would test again in two days and let them know. I tested positive again so had to cancel this flight as I would not be able to travel to Costa Rica 😩. They sent me the fine, fine print in my contract that said all I could get was. Credit to use within six months. Mind you their website says you can cancel up to 7 days before flight. Which I did ! Very deceitful..the amount of my flight was $122.00 so it’s not the money that’s the problem here. It’s the deceitfulness of this company! Do not use this company! They ar dishonest!
reviews.author: patty c

reviews.title: Completely unreliable
reviews.text: One hour before take-off we were told that the flight was going to be delayed one hour, in the end this turned out to be several hours and we were given absolutely no information only that the flight would “come soon”. I would never book with them again if you have a connecting flight or any other transportation you need to catch the same day. In addition, it took them over one week to respond to my e-mails and the refuse to refund me.
reviews.author: Caroline

reviews.title: Company made me wait for 6h then offered reimbursement that they now claim is not possible
reviews.text: I arrived 2 minutes late for check in and they had already put me as no show and checked new passengers in my place. They offered me to wait for no shows on the next flights. After 4 hours they offered me a reimbursement through the website that way I could fly with another company that had availability. Paid for new flight and now Sansa claims they can’t reimburse me.
reviews.author: Gloria B

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: **Destination Drakes Bay - TA won't allow Drakes Bay as a destination** Great return flights to Drakes Bay from SJO. Easy check in both ends. Luggage restrictions didn't seem so bad as some people make out. Just be sensible. 30lbs and then must pay a small surcharge if more. Lovely new domestic terminal in SJO 2-minute walk from international terminal. New terminal in Drakes Bay as well. Wonderful experience on the Grand Caravan and of course amazing view of Costa Rica as you fly. I notice lots of adverse comments here but that's certainly not our experience. Sansa was also extremely helpful and flexible. We had to re-arrange our flights 3 times due to Covid. Absolutely no problem for them.
reviews.author: Steven N

reviews.title: Do not trust verbal information
reviews.text: Please don’t encourage this airline to operate. Terrible service, misleading, and do not expect to travel with luggage. Claimed plane was full. Yes it was full but would not even put our overhead carryons with us on flight. They send all the luggage for 12 passengers the next day and not information on when it would arrive. Then you must go and retrieve your own luggage. Tamarindo airport is privately owned, no security and staff not willing to help. Lucky we travel with luggage trackers.
reviews.author: tim c

reviews.title: Dont expect to travel with your luggage
reviews.text: On our flight down to Golfito we had an extra bag which they charged us a reasonable $44 extra. However, they did not allow us to travel with our bags. They said the plane was over weight. We had to wait for 4 hours in the blazing heat for the next flight to bring our bags. On the return trip we had one bag each and they were less than 30 lbs each yet AGAIN our bags were left behind and another 4 hour wait in San Jose to retrieve our bags. Never again, i would rather pay $1000 and charter or drive! With the delays, driving is faster and you can travel with whatever you want. They are rude and uncaring about your plans. Perhaps if they would eliminate one passenger per flight, they could accommodate the current flights luggage.
reviews.author: Karen10075

reviews.title: very good experience
reviews.text: flew with Sansa from San Jose to drake bay and return, (put palmar sur in flying to box because drake bay is not in the system of tripadviser yet). very happy with the overall experience, easy and professional flight, on time and on both airports very friendly and helpful staff.
reviews.author: serge
reviews.route: San Jose - Province of San Jose

reviews.title: Good experience
reviews.text: Recommedations to call airline and check flight status the day prior. Our flight time changed to two hours earlier. They are slow with email confirmations and email changes. Given all of this, our experience was great. But make sure you confirm, confirm, confirm by phone. Our flight was on time with the new flight time.
reviews.author: Laurie L

reviews.title: One good experience, one bad experience
reviews.text: We booked two flights with Sansa. The first went off without a hitch, some choppy weather but the pilots did their best to fly around or over the weather and brought us in safe and quick. The second was rescheduled one day before departure and they expected us to leave two hours later, then fly to another regional airport and then on to San Jose. Our schedule couldn't accommodate the changes so we had to arrange for ground transport at the last minute and Sansa will not provide any refunds only a credit that is valid for six months, which is useless unless your traveling to Costa Rica very frequently. I would use them again, but I would not book more than a couple days in advance.
reviews.author: Justin S

reviews.title: Bad Airline - Plane left way before we showed up
reviews.text: Flight left easily 20 minutes before departure time. Tried to call customer service, tried to be totally reasonable. Terrible customer service, no refund, no partial reimbursement.
reviews.author: macappie

reviews.title: Horrible service- change hours flight at their like
reviews.text: Airline change the flight from 20 mints to 1and a half yesterday to make an extra stop, terrible service also charge for transportation after huge inconvenience, the lady at the front desk asked me to just leave a review if I didn’t like it
reviews.author: Orlando T

reviews.title: Gets you from point A to B
reviews.text: Honestly I was very nervous to go on this plane considering it’s very tiny and only has one engine, but the flight was 20 minutes and we had no issues. The pilots are very well trained and the truth is aviation is much more safe these days. Before you book your flight make sure you’re 100% sure of your decision because they don’t refund, the airline only gives a credit to use within a certain time period. On my way back from Liberia to San Jose we had a drop off in Tambor and the flight took about 45 minutes and the turbulence was a bit more. The plane is very small so you feel every gust of wind. Take a drememine and you’ll be okay. It was a cool experience overall. Staff at check in is friendly and we actually ended up leaving the airport early since everyone was already there! Personally I had a good experience.
reviews.author: Carolyne H

reviews.title: WORST TRIP EVER
reviews.text: HORRiBLE SERVICE - HORRIBLE STAFF! The worst part of my trip was flying with these people who should NOT BE ALLOWED TO Operate this type of business. Waited three hours for a disgusting plane to pick us up - (so gross -literally made my stomach turn) not sure the pilot even valid to fly - SCARIEST FLIGHT EVER! We opted to not take the flight back but to rent a car and drive - and it turned out to be one of the best times Taty we had. It was very safe and so much fun to venture and drive to our next destination. DRIVE DO NOT FLY with the people. They don’t care about you - they only want there money. Once they’ve charged you - that’s it - Zero communication.
reviews.author: ABee

reviews.title: Do Not book from this company
reviews.text: They make you wait two hours extra from when it was scheduled. And then it’s too late to fly. I would recommend flying or just making the drive. I tell you do not book here as you will regret. The same thing happens to the two flights before me. All their pilots must not know how to fly. Never book here.
reviews.author: Marcus

reviews.title: It all turned out fine; But what if?
reviews.text: So we booked several of our internal flights in Costa Rica through Sansa. It all went smoothly, and I have nothing to complain about except for one incident which could have been fairly disastrous. We had booked a flight from Quepos to San Jose. The day before we were to use this flight someone on a tour we were taking mentioned that the airport was under renovation, and that airplanes were not currently using this airport. Concerned, we did a bit of investigating and found out that this was true. They had another plan in place involving going to the Sansa office at the port, where they would then shuttle passengers to an alternate airport 45 minutes away. I never received any notice from Sansa about this plan, no e-mail, no text, no phone call, nothing!!! We only found out about it by chance, and it all turned out fine, but it left me feeling very uneasy about Sansa.
reviews.author: mollymelanie

reviews.title: Thieves
reviews.text: We bought tickets two weeks in advance from La Fortuna to Quepos in Costa Rica. Less than 4 hours before flight they called and cancelled, some issue with La Fortuna airport supposedly. Offered a credit, which we took to be a refund. Turned out they have a no refund policy, even when they screw up. We had to hire an overland driver on short notice at great expense. They said we could credit to a future flight - we are tourists visiting from the US, not some local business people. This is a beautiful country with extraordinarily wonderful people, but this airline is crapola, nothing more.
reviews.author: J D

reviews.title: Borderline Fraudulent Company
reviews.text: I purchased these tickets to visit Tortuga. I purchased tickets that would be refundable and they refused to refund them. I spoke with the sales representative and their manager and they refused. They offered me credit for a year, so now I have a $470 credit that I can't use. Absolutely avoid them!
reviews.author: Kathryn C

reviews.title: They don't give refunds
reviews.text: Ive used Sansa for many years in my trips to Costa Rica, and it has always been a fine experience. BUT this year I had a flight booked for April which I had to cancel. They said they would give me credit and instructed me to buy the tickets and then apply the credit through the call center. SO I bought new tickets for my rescheduled flight for June. The call center hung up on me before I could even speak to anyone---Multiple times. So I sent an email asking If I could use my credit and thinking they would reimburse me. They refused. Apparently I wasn't supposed to buy the ticket first. But thats what they told me to do in the email. So now $600 later i'm left with a credit I cant use and non-refundable tickets. This just doesn't seem fair. Very frustrating.
reviews.author: stephanie

reviews.title: Terrible Airline - They Cancel Your Flight Day Before
reviews.text: TERRIBLE Airline. I have traveled around the world and this is the worst airline ever. I had two flights with them and they moved BOTH flights the day before and gave me an option for the first one to fly out the next day (so lose an entire day) and the second one they moved my flight to when I was flying out on my other flight. And it doesn't stop here - so, I said those don't work for me please cancel. They say - "no we don't refund, only credit" and I said, well I am not coming back here and you changed the flight to times that don't work for me, so you need to refund me. And it doesn't stop there. Refused to refund me and then I disputed with my credit card company (Capital One - another TERRIBLE company) and Sansa lied and said I no-showed so I didn't get a refund. And since it was over 15 days, capital one won't refund. Mind-blowing how these people sleep at night. Don't ever book with them or you'll be out a flight AND your money.
reviews.author: Tjshort

reviews.title: Avoid at all costs!!
reviews.text: Just terrible customer service from start to finish. Flight didn’t arrive and I wasn’t informed and was then told it wasn’t their fault. Avoid avoid avoid. Green sky seemed much better (and much more popular).
reviews.author: Josh

reviews.title: Do not Fly Sansa!
reviews.text: We had a ticket booked to fly from Tambor to San Jose. Sansa cancelled the flight and simply refuses to give us a refund for the ticket. Avoid this company at all costs. There is a much better alternative!
reviews.author: André F
